templates.title: Labels
templates.description: The ZPL templates of each label type. Each change of the ZPL is a new version; the active version is printed.

editor.keyHint: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, such as PRODUCT. It cannot change later.
editor.unchanged: The ZPL did not change: the version is still {{version}}.
editor.previewEmpty: Write the ZPL and the label will appear here.
editor.previewSize: {{width}} × {{length}} dots, {{copies}} copy(ies). The values are samples.
editor.dataHint: The key cannot change after the template is created.

printers.title: Printers
printers.description: The Zebra printers of each warehouse. Labels are sent only to printers on this list.

form.name: Name
form.ipHint: Four numbers from 0 to 255 separated by dots, such as 192.168.1.40.
form.port: Port 9100, the printing port of Zebra printers. It does not change.

print.title: Print label
print.noPrinters: There are no active printers in your warehouses.
print.noPrintersHere: There are no active printers in this location's warehouse.
print.copiesRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

designer.empty: Your label is empty. Start by adding an element:
designer.noField: No field: it prints a fixed text
designer.label: The label
designer.seeZpl: See the ZPL that will be saved
designer.dragHint: You can also drag it inside the label.
designer.boxHint: A box or a line: 4 dots tall is a line.
designer.sizeHint: The size of the roll you buy. 4 × 2 inches is the one the system uses.
designer.unreadable: This ZPL cannot be shown as blocks (it has things the designer does not handle). The design starts empty; your ZPL stays saved until you save the design.
designer.handWritten: This label was written by hand and the designer cannot show it as blocks, so it is shown as it prints and left alone. Duplicate it as a new template to rebuild it with blocks.
designer.dragFromPalette: Drag it onto the label, or press it to add it.
designer.fieldOpen: Write the name of the variable
designer.fieldHint: The name goes between double braces on the label, for example: name. Use letters, numbers and underscore.
designer.suggestions: The ones this label already uses:
designer.resize: Drag the corner to change the size
